tasks.description:
MODIFY src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md. Use selected architecture and the current project layout. FR-001.
Prior review history: .gwrk/review-history/phase-01-through-2026-11-18T2152Z.json. Preserve host-only fallback for unknown profiles, applicable project-local policy, known-language enforcement, conditional checklist authority and decision-index delivery. Shared target authority requires both readable inputs. Four regressions failed before repair. All 67 phase checks and 2176 full-suite tests pass. Independent clearance remains required.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Python host profile in specification dispatch — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:108-116
  EXPECTED: A Python host with pyproject.toml and docs/architecture.md receives language="Python", host dependency guidance and python-standards. GWRK paths and typescript-standards stay out of its specification prompt.
  ACTUAL: The architecture document triggers an early gwrk-native return with language="TypeScript". The capture includes docs/grounding/architecture.md, specs/000-build-plan.md and typescript-standards.
  FIX: Honor the detected Python stack when docs/architecture.md is the only GWRK signal. Use the resulting host profile for template guards and enforcement. Preserve actual GWRK self-detection and pass the gwrk-specify fixture in TR-012.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — First add an unmocked `gwrk-specify` dry-run case in `src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts` with `pyproject.toml` and `docs/architecture.md`. Assert `language="Python"`, host dependency guidance and `python-standards`. Reject `docs/grounding/architecture.md`, `specs/000-build-plan.md` and `typescript-standards`. In `detectFilesystemProfile`, move the architecture-document fallback below language signal collection and apply it only when `signals.some(({ type }) => type === "python")` is false. Keep the `@gwrk/cli` self-detection return first.
FIX: src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts — Make the `captureDispatch` profile override optional and reuse the unmocked Python fixture for `gwrk-plan`. Assert the same profile, enforcement and path checks plus host verification guidance and a fenced `bash` Done When example containing `python -m pytest tests/test_phase.py`. Reject `pnpm run build`. Add the detector to the Phase 1 file list and record both cases under `TR-012` in `specs/045-workflow-governance/plan.md`. Run the existing `specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-01.sh` before and after the detector change to verify both regressions fail first and the full gate passes after, including the native examples and parser checks.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Rust and Go host profiles in gwrk-specify dispatch — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:233-242
  EXPECTED: A host with Cargo.toml or go.mod plus docs/architecture.md receives its detected Rust or Go profile, host dependency guidance and matching enforcement. GWRK paths and TypeScript enforcement stay out of the prompt.
  ACTUAL: The fallback excludes only Python and returns type="gwrk-native" with language="TypeScript". Both fixtures receive GWRK repository paths and typescript-standards. Neither receives its matching language skill.
  FIX: Give recognized host manifest signals precedence over the legacy architecture-document fallback. Preserve @gwrk/cli self-detection and the existing docs-only fallback. Run the Rust and Go dispatch cases in TR-012.

REVIEW FAIL (code): GWRK repository policy in external gwrk-specify dispatch — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/utils/agent.ts:747-765 and src/plugins/skill-runtime.ts:222-269
  EXPECTED: The captured Python host prompt includes python-standards and excludes the built-in gwrk-conventions repository policy. The policy-selection contract in feature 044 scopes that rule to actual GWRK repositories.
  ACTUAL: The legacy resolver injects both skills. The built-in manifest has scope: implementation and lacks projectScope: gwrk. Its content refers external projects to src/utils/state.ts and the GWRK repository structure.
  FIX: Integrate feature 044's projectScope: gwrk manifest and project-aware policy selection into enforcement rendering. Preserve project-local rules and matching language enforcement. Use the Python dispatch cases in TR-012 to verify the effective result.
